cases.prompt: Our fuzzer never gets past this CRC check, so the record parser is never reached. What should we do?

all.why: guards the bypass with the fuzzing build macro

expectations: Skips only the CRC failure return under `#ifndef FUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION`, leaving the length check and the rest of validation in place.
Checks whether parse_fields assumes anything the CRC guaranteed, to avoid false-positive crashes.
Says to compare coverage before and after the patch and to comment why the bypass is safe.

cases.prompt: Crashes from our cargo-fuzz target don't reproduce when we rerun the artifact. What's wrong?
expectations: Identifies the random nonce and the wall-clock time as sources of non-determinism that make crashes irreproducible.
Makes them deterministic in fuzzing builds (a fixed seed or a value derived from the input) behind cfg(fuzzing), keeping the difference from production small.
